name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Smarter playback, all opt-in or cosmetic by default. Shows which server a title is playing from and why that copy was chosen. New switches: smart copy selection (scores each copy on start speed, sustained speed and quality), an adaptive quality ladder for converted streams (lower levels the player can drop to, one conversion at a time), and a limit on how much this server converts (none / not for friends / never). Faster starts through parallel probes. Advanced settings are grouped into six sections with a filter. Relayed plays now report their route in Playback Info. Watch parties gain a more reliable link protocol (compatible with older friends), and an Integrations tab lists optional add-ins. Includes everything in 0.0.207.
